description: Start a timer on a project. Stops any other running timer first — Timebook allows only one active timer at a time.

description.description: What the user is working on (visible in the time entry).

project.description: Project id (UUID) or exact project name. Use list_projects to discover.

rate.description: Optional rate id (UUID) or exact rate name (e.g. "Software Development").

name: start_timer
